Name: Hogwarts - A School of Witchcraft and Wizardry (WIP)
Author: sexynes
Description:
[b][size=4]Work-in-progress/pre-alpha development stage[/size]
[/b]This expansion originated from a desire to tell Harry Potter stories and immerse oneself in the magical universe of HP within a medium we all love, Stardew Valley. Regardless if one is not a fan, everybody is welcome to participate in this expansion; we ask that people be civil and respectful. 

We are in the process of creating areas and game assets for players and NPCs to utilize and interact with; Wizard-type NPCs are welcome to reside in this expansion, if a home is needed. Players can go to available areas by interacting with the fireplace at the Wizard's Tower.
